sources.content: Spec CV-7: incremental snapshots in Corvanta. Today Corvanta takes a full copy of each volume every night, which takes about six hours for a 2 TB volume. This change adds incremental snapshots that copy only blocks changed since the previous snapshot. Corvanta tracks changed blocks with a bitmap stored in /var/lib/corvanta/bitmaps. A full snapshot still runs every Sunday to bound restore chains. Restores replay at most six incremental snapshots on top of the last full one.

Limits: incremental snapshots are not supported for volumes smaller than 10 GB, which keep nightly full copies. Encryption keys stay unchanged, so existing snapshots remain readable. Rollout: version 3.4 ships the feature off by default behind the setting incremental = true. Operators should run corvanta verify after the first week to compare checksums against a full snapshot. If verification fails, Corvanta falls back to full snapshots and raises an alert.

claims.text: Corvanta tracks changed blocks with a bitmap.

A full Corvanta snapshot still runs every Saturday.

If verification fails, Corvanta falls back to full snapshots.
A Corvanta restore replays at most six incremental snapshots.
